# Simple Carousel (`fancy/simple-carousel`)

Swipeable horizontal carousel with snap; the gallery recipe default.

- **Weight**: 1.3 KiB JS + 0.1 KiB CSS (own, gzip); 53.6 KiB with vendor deps. **Lite**: true. **Touch**: true. **Reduced motion**: reduced.
- **License**: MIT, tier A, from `danielpetho/fancy@f9f62c61207b` by daniel petho.
- **Deps**: `motion`.

## Usage

```tsx
import { SimpleCarousel } from "./kit/fancy/simple-carousel";

<SimpleCarousel direction={…} baseVelocity={…} easing={…} />
```

## Props

| Prop | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `direction` | `"left" \| "right" \| "up" \| "down"?` |
| `baseVelocity` | `number?` |
| `easing` | `(value: number) => number?` |
| `slowdownOnHover` | `boolean?` |
| `slowDownFactor` | `number?` |
| `slowDownSpringConfig` | `SpringOptions?` |
| `useScrollVelocity` | `boolean?` |
| `scrollAwareDirection` | `boolean?` |
| `scrollSpringConfig` | `SpringOptions?` |
| `scrollContainer` | `RefObject<HTMLElement \| null> \| HTMLElement \| null?` |
| `repeat` | `number?` |
| `draggable` | `boolean?` |
| `dragSensitivity` | `number?` |
| `dragVelocityDecay` | `number?` |
| `dragAwareDirection` | `boolean?` |
| `dragAngle` | `number?` |
| `grabCursor` | `boolean?` |

## Compose

1. Inside a shell `.panel` as the screen's one hero element, with the headline in `--font-body` and labels in `.kicker`.
2. As a row in a list/card (`.item`, `.card`) where it is decoration for the text next to it — then it must be `aria-hidden`.

## Failure modes

- Pulls `motion` (shared with other motion components; counted once per app).

## Air tokens

Colours, radii and fonts come from `kit/air/theme.css` custom properties (`--ink`, `--accent`, `--panel-bg`, `--ring`, `--radius-*`, `--font-*`); pass them through `className`/`style`, never literals.
